item.title: Mpris2awtrix
item.description: This guide configures your Ulanzi/Awtrix 3 display to show notifications with the currently playing track’s artist and title whenever a new song starts on any MPRIS-compatible media player (Feishin , Spotify, Firefox, VLC, etc.) on your Linux machine. It uses dbus2mqtt to forward media player events over MQTT, which are then picked up by Home Assistant and sent to the Awtrix display.
